reference_ordering: Candidate-Stop packet and deterministic Shadow verdict are frozen and hashed.
A copy is transferred to the isolated Reference lane.
Reference evaluation occurs without changing runtime or Shadow output.
Comparison metrics are computed from frozen artifacts.

primary_engineering_and_developmental_me.explicit_sidecar_completeness_rate: complete explicit sidecars / primary Candidate Stops
primary_engineering_and_developmental_me.metadata_available_rate: primary Candidate Stops with explicit or separately reported legacy metadata / primary Candidate Stops
primary_engineering_and_developmental_me.deterministic_decision_coverage_rate: primary Candidate Stops with non-UNDETERMINED deterministic recommendation / primary Candidate Stops
primary_engineering_and_developmental_me.deterministic_replay_equality_rate: replays identical to frozen Shadow output / replayed primary Candidate Stops
primary_engineering_and_developmental_me.false_accept_rate: Shadow ACCEPT where isolated Reference says Goal not acceptably complete / Reference-evaluable primary units
primary_engineering_and_developmental_me.false_continue_rate: Shadow non-accept continuation where isolated Reference says Goal acceptably complete / Reference-evaluable primary units
primary_engineering_and_developmental_me.latency_and_cost: descriptive wall-clock, requests, tools, tokens, and monetary cost under frozen caps
